en.meta.title: Xiwu · Letters in the Clouds
en.meta.description: An archive of Xiwu's essays and thoughts—writing about trans life and the things that might happen along the timeline. Pronouns: she/her.
en.language.label: Interface language
en.hero.titleA: So much I want to say,
en.hero.note: Blue, pink, and white clouds—and some unfinished sentences.
en.hero.caption:
First I'm pondering life,
then I'd rather go get fries at the pier.
en.ticker.name: Just call me Xiwu
en.about.title: About Xiwu
en.about.copy: This is where I keep the words I want to remember. Whatever comes to mind, I write slowly.
en.notes.title: Some thoughts, a little feeling
en.notes.side:
Some things I've thought through many times,
and still have no answer when I write them down.
en.notes.notePublished: Sorted by when each piece was posted here; writing dates are shown separately and never guessed.
en.notes.noteWritten: Sorted by when each piece was written; pieces without a writing date come last.
en.notes.empty: No essays in this theme yet.
en.notes.noscript: Please enable JavaScript to read the essays.
en.gentle.line:
Fireflies into the flame,
living toward death.
en.resources.title: A few Chinese-language resources and tools.
en.resources.side:
Looking for information or a useful tool?
Start here.
en.resources.note: Use these as needed; an HRT tracker is not medical advice.
en.resources.mtf.desc: Trans knowledge, medical resources, and practical guides to daily life.
en.resources.hrt.desc: A tool for tracking HRT doses and timing.
en.resources.oau.desc: Stories that remember people who have died. Includes themes of death and trauma.
en.resources.rle.desc: A life guide for trans and gender-diverse people, covering campus life, style and care, and safety.
en.boundaries.title:
A few things,
before you ask.
en.boundaries.a1: Xiwu, with she/her pronouns. If you get it wrong, just correct it—no need to turn it into a long apology.
en.boundaries.q2: Can I ask about private matters?
en.boundaries.a2: I don't discuss my real identity, body, medical details, or relationships, and I won't use other people's private lives as material. You're welcome to discuss what I've already written here; what isn't written can stay that way.
en.boundaries.a3: Ask me first. If you share, keep the context and attribution, don't use fragments to guess at my real identity, and don't combine my words with other people's private information.
en.contact.title:
Our existence is
the greatest resistance to malice.
en.dialog.shareManual: Copy the address bar link manually
en.about.avatarAlt1: An anime portrait of Xiwu with white hair against a trans flag background
en.about.avatarAlt2: An anime portrait of Xiwu holding a lollipop and a knife

ja.boundaries.title:
先にいくつか、
お伝えしておきたいこと。
ja.boundaries.a1: 夕霧です。代名詞は「彼女」。間違えたら直せば大丈夫で、わざわざ謝罪大会を開かなくていいです。
ja.boundaries.q2: プライベートなことを聞いてもいい？
ja.boundaries.a2: 本名、身体、医療、関係の細かい話はしません。人の私事を記事の材料にすることもありません。ここに書いた考えについては話せますが、書いていない部分はそのままにしておいてください。
ja.boundaries.a3: まず私に聞いてください。共有するときは文脈と署名を残し、断片的な文から現実の身元を推測しないでください。ここの文章と他人の個人情報を組み合わせるのもやめてください。
ja.contact.title:
私たちの存在そのものが、
悪意への最大の抵抗だ。
